note: Folders, tracks, grand doctrines, subdoctrines, rewards and milestones of the doctrine system. A 'blocks' entry is a unit stat block: target is a sub-unit id or a category_* key, stats are unit stats, terrain nests a terrain block. 'modifiers' are country modifiers. A reward key becomes <subdoctrine>_<reward> in localisation. The third reward of every subdoctrine needs 150 mastery (the spec's rule for the sea and sky, applied to the land for consistency). 'home' lists who the AI favours (strings as in the technology 'who' field). Nothing here touches ap_attack: the deathless invariant of warfare section 5.

folders.name: Doctrine of the Host
folders.desc: How the hosts of a realm are taught to stand, march and break.

folders.name: Sea Doctrine
folders.desc: How the fleets of a realm are taught to row, sail and board.

folders.name: Doctrine of the Winged
folders.desc: How the winged are taught to hunt, scout and strike.

folders.name: Hidden Doctrine
folders.desc: Held in reserve. Nothing of this folder is shown.

grand.name: The Shield Wall
grand.desc: Hold the line, dig in and let the foe break upon it. The doctrine of Aenor and the old crowns.

grand.name: Horse and Lance
grand.desc: Strike from the saddle and let the foot follow. The doctrine of the riders of the plains.

grand.name: The Great Muster
grand.desc: Call every able man to the banner. A host of many makes up in numbers what it lacks in craft.

grand.name: The Old Ways
grand.desc: The elves fight as they have always fought: by ground, by bow and by patience.

grand.name: The Sun Guard
grand.desc: Few, tall and slow to move, the Sunhot hold a field as a wall holds a gate.

grand.name: Blood and Warband
grand.desc: A warband lives for the charge. It hits first, hits hardest and hits in the dark.

grand.name: Strength of the Wild
grand.desc: The great kin fight as they live: in groves, on mountains and in the cold, and they are hard to move.

grand.name: Nether Fury
grand.desc: The Netherborn fight with the fury of those who have nothing left to lose.

grand.name: The Grave Muster
grand.desc: The dead rise, march and fall, and rise again at the next muster.

grand.name: The Deathless Tide
grand.desc: The dead that Zol raises need no rest, no bread and no hope. They stand because he wills it.

grand.name: The Command of the Sea
grand.desc: Win the sea with the weight of the line: warships in order of battle, galleys on the flanks.

grand.name: Oar and Ram
grand.desc: Win the coast with fast galleys: oars for speed, the ram for the kill and boarders to follow.

grand.name: The Corsair Fleets
grand.desc: Win the trade with hidden hulls: strike the cogs, burn the quays and be gone by dawn.

grand.name: Wings of the Mountain
grand.desc: The doctrine of dragon pacts: few wings, great strength and a rider who knows his beast.
grand.availableRaw: OR = { zin_tech_people_elves = yes zin_tech_people_sun_elves = yes has_country_flag = zin_war_dragon_pact check_variable = { zin_dragon_flights > 0 } }

grand.name: Griffin Eyries
grand.desc: The doctrine of the bred beasts: many wings, quick and light, loosed from the cliff-top roosts.

subs.name: Shield and Spear
subs.desc: Short spears over locked shields: the foot hold their ground and dig in where they stand.

rewards.name: Locked Rims
rewards.desc: Shields overlap more closely, and fewer blows find a gap.

rewards.name: Second Rank Thrusts
rewards.desc: The rank behind thrusts over the shoulders of the first.

rewards.name: Ground Held
rewards.desc: A line that has dug in does not give the ground back.

subs.name: Archer Screens
subs.desc: Archers loose over the heads of the foot, and the enemy has to close under a hail of shafts.

rewards.name: Massed Volleys
rewards.desc: Whole companies loose together, and the arrows fall as one.

rewards.name: Covering Fire
rewards.desc: Archers shoot from behind stakes and shields, and are hard to reach.

rewards.name: Long Draws
rewards.desc: Archers practise until their draw is long and steady, and their fire holds to the last shaft.

subs.name: Levy Drill
subs.desc: Levies are called up, drilled at the village green and sent home, and a realm can raise a host in half the time.

rewards.name: Muster Days
rewards.desc: Fixed days of drill each season keep every village ready.

rewards.name: Drilled Hands
rewards.desc: Levies who have drilled together keep their nerve longer.

rewards.name: Village Pride
rewards.desc: Men fight harder beside their neighbours and give up less easily.

subs.name: Skirmish Lines
subs.desc: Foot fight in open order, scouting ahead and falling back before a charge.

rewards.name: Light Marching
rewards.desc: Packs are trimmed to the bare need, and the column moves faster.

rewards.name: Watchful Pickets
rewards.desc: A ring of pickets warns the camp long before the foe is near.

rewards.name: Broken-Ground Fighting
rewards.desc: Skirmishers are taught to use every ditch and thicket.

subs.name: Warband Rush
subs.desc: The warband charges at once and in a mass, and the first blow decides the fight.

rewards.name: First Charge
rewards.desc: The first rush is the hardest blow a warband can strike.

rewards.name: Howling Host
rewards.desc: The din of a charging warband breaks the nerve of less fierce foes.

rewards.name: Fury Unchecked
rewards.desc: Once the warband is committed, nothing can turn it.

subs.name: Forest Ways
subs.desc: Elven foot know the forest as no other host does, and fight best among the trees.

rewards.name: Silent Steps
rewards.desc: The elves cross the leaf-mould without a sound.

rewards.name: Branch and Shadow
rewards.desc: Archers shoot from the boughs and are seen only after the shaft lands.

rewards.name: The Green Wall
rewards.desc: In their own woods the elves are a wall that cannot be seen until it strikes.

subs.name: Grave Ranks
subs.desc: The risen dead are drilled in dense ranks, and an order given to one is carried out by all.

rewards.name: Rank on Rank
rewards.desc: The grave hosts close up as one body, and a blow that fells one does not shake the others.

rewards.name: Unbroken Silence
rewards.desc: A host that never cries out cannot be frightened by cries.

rewards.name: No Retreat
rewards.desc: The grave hosts have no will to flee, and each body must be struck down where it stands.

subs.name: Siege Parks
subs.desc: Engines, ladders, rams and carters travel in one park, and a host can sit down before any wall.

rewards.name: Ram and Ladder
rewards.desc: Rams and scaling ladders go forward with the engines, so a breach is stormed at once.

rewards.name: Sap the Foot
rewards.desc: Diggers tunnel beneath a wall and prop its foundation, then burn the props.

rewards.name: Wall Breakers
rewards.desc: Crews trained on one wall after another learn exactly where a wall is weakest.

subs.name: Field Engines
subs.desc: Light engines travel with the host and shoot in the open, not only at walls.

rewards.name: Light Frames
rewards.desc: Frames of ash and rope can be taken apart, carried and raised again in an hour.

rewards.name: Ranged Shots
rewards.desc: Crews learn to range their engines by marks cut into the frame.

rewards.name: Always Ready
rewards.desc: Spare skeins, spare arms and a spare hand for every engine.

subs.name: Bolt Walls
subs.desc: Ballistae and scorpions are set in rows behind the line, and a charge of horse or monster runs into a wall of bolts.

rewards.name: Long Bolts
rewards.desc: Heavier bolts with broader heads fly further and bite deeper.

rewards.name: Rows of Scorpions
rewards.desc: Scorpions set wheel to wheel make a fence that nothing winged can cross.

rewards.name: Steady Beds
rewards.desc: Engines mounted on deeper beds stand firm and are harder to overturn.

subs.name: Sappers' Craft
subs.desc: Sappers lay bridges, breach palisades and dig a host across any river in a night.

rewards.name: Pontoon Teams
rewards.desc: Teams carry boats and planks on their backs and bridge a stream before the foe can react.

rewards.name: Mine and Counter-Mine
rewards.desc: Sappers hear the enemy's tunnels through the earth and dig to meet them.

rewards.name: Night Work
rewards.desc: Sappers do their hardest work in the dark, where no archer can find them.

subs.name: Heavy Charge
subs.desc: Mailed knights ride in tight ranks at the centre of the foe's line, and what they hit does not stand.

rewards.name: Closed Knees
rewards.desc: Knights ride knee to knee, and no gap opens for a lance to enter.

rewards.name: Weight of Iron
rewards.desc: Horse and rider together meet the line like a falling wall.

rewards.name: The Last Thunder
rewards.desc: The knights rally for one more charge, and the host is moved by the sight.

subs.name: Raiding Riders
subs.desc: Light riders live off the land and strike far behind the line.

rewards.name: Fast Forage
rewards.desc: Riders take what they need from the country they cross.

rewards.name: Hit and Away
rewards.desc: Raiders strike, wheel and go before the foe is ready.

rewards.name: Far Riding
rewards.desc: Riders learn the long roads and cross a province in a day.

subs.name: Horse Archery
subs.desc: Mounted bowmen shoot at the gallop and are gone before the foe can answer.

rewards.name: Parting Volleys
rewards.desc: A rider shoots over his shoulder as he withdraws, and the pursuit is checked.

rewards.name: Light Mail
rewards.desc: A short coat of rings is light enough for a bowman in the saddle.

rewards.name: Wheel and Loose
rewards.desc: The whole line wheels as one and looses as it turns.

subs.name: Kin Handling
subs.desc: Drovers and speakers learn to command the great kin and keep them in the fight.

rewards.name: Drovers' Calls
rewards.desc: A call, a horn and a goad keep a troll or a giant standing when it would flee.

rewards.name: Goad and Rein
rewards.desc: Handlers drive the kin at the weakest point of the foe's line.

rewards.name: Rage Harnessed
rewards.desc: A kin that has been well handled can take a wound and fight on.

subs.name: War Councils
subs.desc: Captains meet before the march, draw the plan on the table and each know what the others will do.

rewards.name: Chart Tables
rewards.desc: Maps of the realm are kept in one hall, and a plan can be made in days.

rewards.name: Counsel of Captains
rewards.desc: Captains of long standing are heard, and the plan is better for it.

rewards.name: One Voice
rewards.desc: In battle the whole host moves to one command.

subs.name: Hold the Line
subs.desc: The host is taught to stay in its trenches and let the enemy tire himself on its works.

rewards.name: Deep Ditches
rewards.desc: Ditches dug twice as deep keep the foe at the foot of the rampart.

rewards.name: Sentries on the Works
rewards.desc: Sentries on every rampart see an attack before it starts.

rewards.name: Not a Step Back
rewards.desc: A line that will not yield can be broken only by killing every man in it.

subs.name: Long Marches
subs.desc: The host learns to cover great distances in good order and arrive ready to fight.

rewards.name: Road Discipline
rewards.desc: A column that keeps its order loses fewer men to the road.

rewards.name: Foraging Parties
rewards.desc: Parties sent ahead gather food from the country before the host arrives.

rewards.name: Forced Pace
rewards.desc: A host trained to march hard reaches the field a day sooner.

subs.name: Ambush and Raid
subs.desc: Strike from cover, strike at night, and withdraw before the enemy can gather.

rewards.name: Darkened Blades
rewards.desc: Blades blackened with soot do not shine in moonlight.

rewards.name: Forest Hides
rewards.desc: Fighters learn to wait in cover without a sound.

rewards.name: Rolling Withdrawal
rewards.desc: A raiding party falls back in good order, covering its own retreat.

subs.name: Dread
subs.desc: The sight of the host is itself a weapon, and the foe who sees it has lost heart before the first blow.

rewards.name: Black Banners
rewards.desc: Black banners and drums announce the host a day before it arrives.

rewards.name: Terror of the Dark
rewards.desc: The dark hours belong to the host, and the foe will not stand in them.

rewards.name: No Quarter
rewards.desc: A foe that knows no mercy is shown will break sooner.

subs.name: Ram and Grapple
subs.desc: Close with the foe, ram him and board in the confusion.

rewards.name: Iron-Shod Prows
rewards.desc: Prows shod with iron strike harder and break less.

rewards.name: Grapnel Drill
rewards.desc: Crews learn to hold a ship fast with hooks and chains.

rewards.name: Boarders at the Rail
rewards.desc: Boarders wait at the rail and spring the moment the hulls touch.

subs.name: Coastal Watch
subs.desc: Galleys keep the home waters, with watch-fires on every headland.

rewards.name: Harbour Chain Drill
rewards.desc: Crews practise closing the harbour chain before the foe's prow is in the mouth.

rewards.name: Signal Fires
rewards.desc: A line of fires along the coast passes a warning from port to port.

rewards.name: Home Waters
rewards.desc: Fleets that fight near their harbours are fed and mended with ease.

subs.name: Oar Squadrons
subs.desc: Galleys keep station in lines of oars and can turn, charge and withdraw as one.

rewards.name: Rowers' Pride
rewards.desc: Rowers who have pulled together for years keep a stroke that does not tire.

rewards.name: Swift Withdrawal
rewards.desc: A squadron can back water and be gone before the foe has closed.

rewards.name: Packs of Galleys
rewards.desc: Galleys hunt in packs and surround a lone warship.

subs.name: Line of Battle
subs.desc: Warships sail in one line, bow to stern, and fire in order, each covering the next.

rewards.name: Closed Ranks
rewards.desc: A line sailed close leaves no gap for a ram to enter.

rewards.name: Flagship Banners
rewards.desc: The admiral's banner flies high, and every captain sees it.

rewards.name: Concentrated Volleys
rewards.desc: The whole line fires at the same mark, and the mark does not survive.

subs.name: Ballista Decks
subs.desc: Decks of ballistae sweep the enemy's rail with long bolts.

rewards.name: Long Bolts
rewards.desc: Heavier bolts with longer shafts carry further across the water.

rewards.name: Catapult Fire
rewards.desc: Catapult decks fling stones and burning pots at the enemy's sails.

rewards.name: Steady Aim
rewards.desc: Crews learn to wait for the roll of the sea and loose on the rise.

subs.name: Sea Castles
subs.desc: Great warships are built as floating castles, tall and thick, and almost impossible to board.

rewards.name: Layered Timbers
rewards.desc: Hulls planked two and three layers deep stop a ram that would stave a lighter ship.

rewards.name: Bastion Decks
rewards.desc: Fighting towers at bow and stern shoot down into any boat that comes alongside.

rewards.name: Fire Watch
rewards.desc: A fire watch with buckets and wet hides keeps burning pitch from taking hold.

subs.name: Night Raiders
subs.desc: Raiders strike under cover of darkness and hide by day.

rewards.name: Dark Hulls
rewards.desc: Hulls blackened with tar and sails dyed the shade of dusk.

rewards.name: Strikes in the Dark
rewards.desc: Raiders learn to find their quarry by sound and by the stars.

rewards.name: Slip Away
rewards.desc: After the strike a raider turns for the nearest cove and is lost to sight.

subs.name: Corsair Packs
subs.desc: Raiders hunt in threes and fall on a cog from all sides.

rewards.name: Packs of Three
rewards.desc: Three hulls working together take a cog that one could not.

rewards.name: Shared Lookouts
rewards.desc: Lookouts on each hull call to the others, and the pack sees twice as far.

rewards.name: Rally Cry
rewards.desc: A cry from the lead hull and every raider turns as one.

subs.name: Dread Ships
subs.desc: A ship that burns the quays of a port has taught every port to fear its name.

rewards.name: Pitch and Fire
rewards.desc: Fire-pots in the bows set a rival's sails alight before the hulls touch.

rewards.name: Terror of the Dark
rewards.desc: Crews that meet a dread ship at night seldom stay to fight.

rewards.name: Burn the Quays
rewards.desc: A raider in the harbour mouth can set a whole waterfront alight.

subs.name: Cog Escorts
subs.desc: Galleys sail beside the cogs and drive off any raider that comes near.

rewards.name: Lanes Learned
rewards.desc: Escorts learn which waters the raiders prefer and keep to the others.

rewards.name: Watch the Weather
rewards.desc: Pilots read the sky and tell the fleet when to run for harbour.

rewards.name: Sweeps
rewards.desc: Galleys sweep ahead of the cogs and flush out the lurking raiders.

subs.name: Harbour Works
subs.desc: Yards, stores and shipwrights at every quay keep the fleet fed and mended.

rewards.name: Victualling Yards
rewards.desc: Yards stock every harbour with biscuit, water and rope.

rewards.name: Quick Refit
rewards.desc: Shipwrights mend a hull in the time it takes to unload its cargo.

rewards.name: Repair at Sea
rewards.desc: Carpenters aboard every ship mend leaks and splinters while the fleet sails.

subs.name: Ocean Pilots
subs.desc: Pilots who know the stars and the currents guide fleets across the open sea.

rewards.name: Star and Chart
rewards.desc: A pilot with a chart and a clear night can find any shore.

rewards.name: Storm Sense
rewards.desc: Old pilots feel a gale in the swell a day before it breaks.

rewards.name: Landfall
rewards.desc: Pilots who have crossed the sea before know where to land a host.

subs.name: Fire From Above
subs.desc: The dragon is loosed on the host below, and what it burns is not rebuilt.

rewards.name: Scorched Lines
rewards.desc: A dragon burns a whole rank of foot in a single pass.

rewards.name: Strike the Wagons
rewards.desc: Riders learn to burn the baggage first, and the host starves.

rewards.name: Near the Front
rewards.desc: Roosts are set close to the line, and a dragon can be there in an hour.

subs.name: Storm Riders
subs.desc: Dragons ride the gale over open water and fall on ships from out of the cloud.

rewards.name: Over Grey Water
rewards.desc: A dragon can find a single ship in an empty sea.

rewards.name: Through the Gale
rewards.desc: A rider and his beast learn to fly where others cannot.

rewards.name: Beacon-Guided
rewards.desc: Watch-fires on the coast guide the dragon home through cloud and night.

subs.name: Lance Wings
subs.desc: Griffin knights ride in tight wings with levelled lances and sweep the sky clear.

rewards.name: Closed Wings
rewards.desc: A wing that flies close breaks a lone foe in a single pass.

rewards.name: Close Formation
rewards.desc: Riders learn to turn together, and the wing becomes one beast.

rewards.name: Veteran Lances
rewards.desc: A wing that has lost no one learns to lose no one.

subs.name: Eyrie Scouts
subs.desc: Scouts ride high over the home country and see every raider long before it reaches the roosts.

rewards.name: Watch Posts
rewards.desc: Posts on every hilltop signal the wing before the foe is in sight.

rewards.name: Home Skies
rewards.desc: Riders who know their own valleys fight best above them.

rewards.name: Wide Eyes
rewards.desc: A scout sees a whole province in one sweep and returns to say what is in it.

hidden.name: Held in Reserve
hidden.desc: Nothing of this doctrine is shown. It exists so that the folder is not empty.

rewards.name: Reserve One
rewards.desc: Held in reserve.

rewards.name: Reserve Two
rewards.desc: Held in reserve.

rewards.desc: Held in reserve.
